{"question":{"id":"q04","question":"这副身体原主人苏天晴的死因是什么？","readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":21}},"mode":"source","remainingQueries":3,"answerRequired":false,"history":[{"requests":[{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":2,"query":"苏天晴"},{"command":"source","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"chapter":1,"query":"苏天晴"},{"command":"entities","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10,"query":"苏天晴"}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-2","sourceManifest":"manifest:5f3e24ecdc495fd9","knowledgeRevision":2,"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":87},"contentHash":"e2fbce45f27fc3120348bb019db2e5a383d462324b773e238d4d4825b6c76891"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":21},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":6,"text":"吐掉嘴里的牙膏泡沫，苏天晴默默放下手中那只可爱的猫猫水杯与牙刷，双手撑住洗手池，抬起脑袋看向镜子里的金毛狐狐。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":17,"text":"与镜中的自己对视了半晌，苏天晴猛然察觉到自己这样的举动很像个变泰，脸颊微红，轻咳两声收敛发癫的状态，开始认真审视起自己身体中残留的记忆。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":18,"text":"这副身体的原主人就叫苏天晴，这里与自己曾经的世界相差无几，但却是人类与兽人共存的一个世界。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c02","revision":1,"chapter":2,"paragraph":20,"text":"虽然名义上共存，但兽人数量远远不及人类，苏天晴从小便独自一人孤独地长大，虽然模样可爱但社恐孤僻，好在有兽人互助协会的资助顺利考上蓉城最好的医学院，却又在临近开学时染上一场兽人流感，熬夜过程中突发了暴发性心肌炎……"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":21},"chapters":[1,2],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":4,"returned":4},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-2","sourceManifest":"manifest:5f3e24ecdc495fd9","knowledgeRevision":2,"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":87},"contentHash":"e2fbce45f27fc3120348bb019db2e5a383d462324b773e238d4d4825b6c76891"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":21},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":5,"text":"“……苏天晴。”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":7,"text":"苏天晴坐在床头，呆滞地看着眼前这本飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，余光从床边的落地镜中扫过，瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影——"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":13,"text":"房间中的低沉言语再次响起，将苏天晴的注意力拽回眼前这本黑色古书。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":14,"text":"苏天晴有些茫然。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":16,"text":"看着在身侧摇曳的炸毛大尾巴，苏天晴鬼使神差地伸手，在尾巴上用力薅了一把。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":23,"text":"苏天晴干咳两声掩饰尴尬，伸手阻止了面前这本奇怪的古书继续说话，眼珠一转，飞快地理清思绪。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":27,"text":"“你是谁？”苏天晴扭头正视眼前这本书，茫然地说道。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":30,"text":"【而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。】"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":31,"text":"再次听完这中二到能让人用脚趾扣出三室一厅的台词，苏天晴又陷入了沉默与思索。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":39,"text":"嘴上不搭调地回答着古书的话，苏天晴脑子里却也对现状有了个大概的了解。"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":2,"paragraph":21},"chapters":[1,2],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":false,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":false,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":18,"returned":10},"truncation":{"page":true,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":"eyJ2ZXJzaW9uIjoxLCJxdWVyeSI6IjFjY2E0Y2MxODUwNzg5ZGY4MThjNDcxYmM2ZWQ1MTg3MWMyZGEwNjZkNWUyMWUzY2NkODg2YTNhMDQzZDVjY2MiLCJvZmZzZXQiOjEwLCJjaGVja3N1bSI6
